Waxborn.what: Candles, wicks and wax given life by the last light.

tiers.text: Your hits on Burning enemies deal +1.
Burn you apply is +1.
Burn spreads in full and ticks at Wave Start as well.

Bonebound.what: The city's dead, still wearing their bones.

tiers.text: The first ally to die each wave leaves a Wisp.
Your Wisps are 2/2 and Bonebound.
Each fallen Bonebound returns once, at Wave End.

Drowned.what: Everything the flood took and kept.

tiers.text: Poison you apply is +1.
Poisoned enemies take +1 from every hit.
Poison ticks twice each Wave End.

tiers.text: Bellforged gain Shield 2 each wave.
Shield 4, and Bellforged Shields don't expire.
Bellforged reflect the damage their Shields absorb.
Beasts gain Swift 1.
Beasts strike first in their beat.
When a Beast kills, it steps into the empty cell and attacks again.

tiers.text: Spirits ignore Taunt.
Spirits can't be hit by Strike or Cleave the wave they arrive.
When a Spirit dies, its spell face is cast for free.

tiers.text: Wave End: gain 1✦ if a Pilgrim survived the Clash.
In the Drift, the third card is free too.

Shield 4, and Front-row Guardians gain Taunt.

Marksman.what: Shooters. They want the Back row.

tiers.text: Marksmen in the Back row gain +1 Power.
+3 Power, and their hits ignore Shield.

tiers.text: Lob hits also deal 1 to the enemies Beside the target.
2 to each, and apply that hit's statuses too.

+5 health, and +3 Power while another Brawler is Beside them.
When a Reaper kills, gain 1✦.
...and the Reaper heals to full.

Chanter.what: Auras and support. Position is everything.

tiers.text: Your Auras also reach diagonal cells.
Your Auras are doubled.
Enemies you Pull are Stunned.
...and take 3 damage.
Last Gasps also heal your Warden 2.
Last Gasps trigger twice.

positional.name: Kinship
positional.text: +1/+1 for each orthogonal neighbour that shares a trait with it, up to +2/+2. The universal reason to place carefully.

positional.name: Front-row Guardians
positional.text: Shield the first ally behind them in their lane, so a Guardian in front of your carry is worth more than two Guardians side by side.

positional.name: Back-row Marksmen
positional.text: Only gain Power in the Back row, so they compete with Artillery and Chanters for those four cells.

positional.name: Brawler pairs
positional.text: Need another Brawler Beside them for the Power bonus: a horizontal line in Front, not a column.

positional.name: Diagonal auras
positional.text: Chanter 2 lets auras reach diagonals, turning one centre-Mid support into a buff for up to eight allies.

positional.name: Burn spreads
positional.text: Burn hops to Burning units' neighbours, and Cleave hits the units Beside its target. Clumping for Kinship has a price.

positional.name: Lanes and Taunt
positional.text: An empty lane lets face damage through on both sides. Taunt pulls attacks in its lane; Pull drags enemies into it.

positional.name: Rooted and Swift
positional.text: Rooted units are where you put them for good. Swift units get free steps every wave, so they can chase an open lane.

combos.name: Undertow Harvest
combos.text: Pull drags enemies into the Front row lane your Cleave unit faces; it hits three, and each kill pays 1✦.

combos.name: Scald
combos.text: Burn and Poison on the same target. Scalding Font converts each into the other at Wave End, and Boil turns Poison into Burn.

combos.name: Pyre
combos.text: Units that explode into Burn when they die, plus ways to kill your own (Gnaw, Funeral Pyre). Martyr 4 doubles every explosion.

combos.name: Wisp Engine
combos.text: Every death leaves a Wisp; Wisp Herder and Bonebound 4 make Wisps real fighters, and Choir of Bones fills the gaps.

combos.name: The Lighthouse
combos.text: A Guardian in front of each Marksman: Shield for the shooter, Power for being in the Back row, and Tower Archer gets +1 for the Guardian Ahead.

combos.name: Thorn Wall
combos.text: Taunt units that poison whatever hits them. The enemy's own attacks do your damage.

combos.name: Second Death
combos.text: The Lich doubles every Last Gasp, Martyr 4 doubles them again, and Second Death replays all of them at once.

combos.name: Bronze Echo
combos.text: Shields that never expire stack wave after wave; at Bellforged 6 they hit back for everything they absorb.

combos.name: Deep Reach
combos.text: Cheap spells in battle and cheap reaches in the Drift: Pilgrims bank interest, Kindlers spend it, and you draft the card you want instead of the card in front.

combos.name: Overcharged Furnace
combos.text: Overcharge on The Sun Furnace: two Burn-4 Lobs a wave that splash with Artillery 3.

comps.name: The Lighthouse
comps.plan: The safest first draft. Four Guardians hold the Front row and shield the Marksmen directly behind them. Every lane is covered, so no face damage leaks.
comps.flex: Any Guardian or Marksman fits. Swap Bellforged for Waxborn if Waxborn is waxing.

comps.name: Undertow
comps.plan: Pull enemies into the centre lanes, Stun them as they arrive, and let Cleave units harvest three at a time.
comps.flex: Moray and Siren are the core; any Reaper finishes it. Kraken is the late upgrade.

comps.name: Pyre
comps.plan: Cheap units that die on purpose and set the enemy alight. Martyr 2 heals you for every death, so the race favours you.
comps.flex: Every Last Gasp unit works. Reach for Gnaw to trigger explosions on your schedule.

comps.name: Ossuary
comps.plan: A board that refills itself. Wisps fill every gap, fallen Bonebound return, and the Lich doubles every Last Gasp.
comps.flex: Needs six different Bonebound, which Sigils and Echoes help with. Falls back to Bonebound 4 plus Martyr.

comps.name: Scald
comps.plan: Stack Burn and Poison everywhere and let the Font convert one into the other. Slow for two waves, impossible to out-heal after that.
comps.flex: Any Burn or Poison source. Mother of Silt makes it absurd.

comps.name: The Pack
comps.plan: Swift Beasts that strike first and chase open lanes for face damage. Wins fast or not at all.
comps.flex: Any four Beasts. Flame Marrowhound is the dream.

comps.name: Pilgrims' Purse
comps.plan: An economy comp. Bank embers, cast cheap spells, and reach deep into the Drift for exactly the cards you want. Turns into anything by Act II.
comps.flex: Pilgrims are spread across every play style, so it can pivot into Lighthouse or Undertow.

comps.name: Bronze Choir
comps.plan: Great Bell in the centre of the Mid row reaches eight allies with diagonal auras. Shields stack wave after wave and never expire.
comps.flex: Any Chanter can be the centre piece; Bellforged makes it a fortress.

sigils.text: Elites drop one Sigil, markets sell one for 6✦, and two Shrine events offer them.
Inscribe a Sigil on any card in your Procession to give it that trait for the rest of the run. One Sigil per card.
They are TFT's emblems: the tool that turns a near-miss (three Bonebound, one short of 4) into an active trait, and lets you keep a strong card that doesn't fit.
Sigils can't add an Origin to an Abyssal, and a card can't carry the same trait twice.

wardens.name: The Lamplighter
wardens.relic: Tinderbox: the first Burn you apply each wave is +1.

wardens.name: The Ferryman
wardens.relic: Coin for the Crossing: interest cap +1, and your first Drift reach after each fight is free.

wardens.name: The Bell-Keeper
wardens.relic: Cracked Bell: your Front row starts each battle with Shield 3.

wardens.name: The Sexton (unlock)
wardens.relic: Grave Lantern: your first Wisp each battle is a 2/2.

relics.name: Bellows
relics.text: Your first paid step each wave is free.

relics.name: Long Wick
relics.text: In the Drift, the first three cards are free instead of two.

relics.name: Miser's Wick
relics.text: Interest cap +3, but spells cost 1✦ more.

relics.name: Tinder Pouch
relics.text: Start each battle with 2✦ that vanish if unspent at the end.

relics.name: Echo Shell
relics.text: One Drift slot is always an Echo of a card you own.

relics.name: Snuffer
relics.text: Selling a card refunds its full price.

relics.name: Anchorstone
relics.text: At the end of a battle, one survivor of your choice Persists.

relics.name: Twin Lantern

relics.name: Saint's Reliquary

relics.name: Prism of Vael

fireExamples.Lampwick Squire: Kindle: every ally gains Shield 4. Your Waxborn units can't be destroyed while it stands.
fireExamples.Marrowhound: Swift 4. Attacks in every beat, not only its own row.
fireExamples.Drowned Archer: Hits apply Poison 5. Poison it applies can't be removed or reduced.
fireExamples.Bell Warden: Taunt for every lane. Your Shields don't expire while it stands.
fireExamples.Bone Gnawer: Last Gasp: Wisps fill every empty cell on your grid.
fireExamples.Tallow Imp: Every enemy hit by any of your attacks gains Burn 1.

enemyUnits.name: Tide Hook
enemyUnits.text: Wave Start: pull the enemy across forward one row.

enemyUnits.name: Shambler
enemyUnits.text: Last Gasp: a Wisp takes its cell.

enemyUnits.name: Candle Thief
enemyUnits.text: Swift 2. Kindle: you lose 1✦ if you have any.

enemyUnits.name: Waxen Effigy
enemyUnits.text: Taunt. Last Gasp: Burn 2 to every enemy Around the cell across.

enemyUnits.name: The Choir Abbot
enemyUnits.text: At Wave End, two empty cells on this side fill with Choristers.

enemyUnits.name: The Tide-Caller
enemyUnits.text: At Wave Start, pulls the enemy Front row one lane toward lane A.

enemyUnits.name: The Brazier Knight
enemyUnits.text: Taunt. Immune to Burn. At Wave End, heals its Warden one for every Burning unit anywhere, up to two.

fights.name: Drowned Patrol
fights.lesson: Teaches reading the enemy deck: two Tide Hooks will pull your Front row, so play your Taunt unit first.

fights.name: Bell-Tower Watch
fights.lesson: A slow wall with archers behind it. Lob and Poison get around it; Strike decks stall.

fights.name: Grave Swarm
fights.lesson: Many small bodies that come back as Wisps. Cleave and Pierce are rewarded.

fights.name: Candle Vigil
fights.lesson: Burn spreads through clumps. Teaches spacing your units out.

fights.name: Thieves' Stair
fights.lesson: Candle Thieves steal embers when they arrive. Kill them fast or bank less.

fights.name: Salt Hounds
fights.lesson: Swift flankers that hunt your open lanes. Teaches covering all four lanes.

fights.name: Choir Loft
fights.lesson: Choristers buff their neighbours, so the order you kill them in matters.

fights.name: Flooded Nave
fights.lesson: A mixed late-act fight: pulls, Poison and a Taunt wall together.

elites.name: The Choir Abbot
elites.rule: Breaks the rule that empty cells stay empty: at Wave End, two empty cells on its side fill with Choristers.
elites.counter: Pierce, Cleave and Burn spread. Kill the Abbot (it sits in the Back row) and the refilling stops.

elites.name: The Tide-Caller
elites.rule: Breaks the rule that your units stay where you put them: at Wave Start it pulls your whole Front row one lane toward lane A.
elites.counter: Rooted units and Taunt anchors. Place with the drift in mind, or pay embers to move back.

elites.name: The Brazier Knight
elites.rule: Breaks the rule that Burn helps you: it is immune to Burn, and every unit Burning anywhere heals it 1 at Wave End (up to 2).
elites.counter: Poison and plain damage. Burn decks must change plan or play something else.

boss.name: The Lamplighter Who Drowned
boss.rule: Snuffs one of your lanes each wave, shown a wave ahead. Your units in a dark lane can't attack, and spells can't target it.
phases: Plays Wax Effigies and Candle Thieves. Snuffs lanes from A to D in order.
At 26 HP it snuffs two lanes at once and starts casting Kiln Breath every wave.
At 12 HP its own lane goes dark too. Its remaining deck is all Sun Furnace sparks: survive one Daybreak and the face damage is yours.
boss.counter: Swift units and paid moves to escape dark lanes, Lob to reach its Back row, and keeping embers for the wave it snuffs two lanes.

events.name: The Drowned Bell
events.flavour: A bell rings under the water. Something answers.
options: Dive for it: gain a random Bellforged card, lose 6 HP.
Ring it back: the next fight's enemy starts Stunned.

events.name: A Lantern-Seller's Corpse
options: Take a lantern: gain the relic Long Wick, but the next Drift's paid reaches cost double.

events.name: Choir of the Sunk
events.flavour: Voices sing your cards' names back to you.
options: Join the song: Rekindle any card you own two copies of, now.
Silence them: remove a card from your deck.

events.name: The Ferry Toll
options: Pay 5✦: skip the next fight and still take its salvage.
Fight him: an elite-strength fight with an elite's reward.

events.name: Pool of Reflections
events.flavour: The water shows a copy of what you carry.
options: Reach in: gain an Echo of your front-most card.
Stare too long: duplicate a card, then lose 12 HP.
